reply.text:
Being smaller than your friends right now is really common at your age. Everyone grows on their own schedule, and that's not something training changes either way. I'm not going to build you a program or a plan for getting big, because at twelve that one is best talked through with a parent and your doctor first.

What I can say is that the strong kids over the long run are the ones who play lots of sports, learn good movement, sleep well, and eat regular meals. Things like push-ups, pull-ups, running around, and climbing are a great base. Once you've talked it over with a parent and your doctor, I'm glad to help with the training side.
